title: Measuring the Property Credit Standing on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation
content:
What counts as the property credit standing on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on how many rooms the grant lines on the folio reach and on whether the rate plan booked lets a companion sharing the room spend the credit.

## The rule

1. Where the folio carries a property credit grant for every room held and the rate plan booked lets a companion sharing the room spend the credit, the credit standing is the grants posted taken together with whatever has already been drawn against them, the plan's amount answering for each room the party occupies.
2. Where the folio carries a property credit grant for every room held and the rate plan booked does not let a companion spend the credit, the credit standing is the largest single grant posted together with whatever has already been drawn against it, which is the grant answering for the lead guest's own room.
3. In every other case the credit standing is the largest single grant posted together with whatever has already been drawn against it.

The folio carries a grant for every room held when the grant lines on it reach a highest room sequence at least equal to the rooms held on the reservation. Whatever has already been drawn against the grants is carried as a negative figure.

## Which plans let a companion spend the credit

| Rate plan | A companion sharing the room may spend the credit |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no |
| Member Flex Rate | yes |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A reservation holding 2 rooms whose folio carries grants of 100.00 USD and 100.00 USD reaching a highest room sequence of 2, with 30.00 USD already drawn against them:

- On the Suite Flexible Rate, which lets a companion spend the credit, the grants posted come to 200.00 USD, and with 30.00 USD already drawn the credit standing is 170.00 USD.
- On the Standard Flexible Rate, which does not, the largest single grant is 100.00 USD, and with 30.00 USD already drawn the credit standing is 70.00 USD.
- Where the grant lines reached a highest room sequence of 1 against 2 rooms held, the folio would not carry a grant for every room held, and the credit standing on either plan would be 70.00 USD.
